thread:
lenora_customer: Hey — after we upgraded to go-sdk v1.4 and enabled JSON mode streaming, our consumer intermittently fails schema validation. Getting 'unexpected token' and 'missing field: created_at' in our validator. Repro attached.

emma_support: Sorry about that — can you paste the raw stream you got and the sdk version?

lenora_customer: sdk v1.4. Raw fragments look like this (copied from tcpdump):

---
{"id":"abc123","text":"hello","created_at":"2026-03-12T10:00:00Z"}
}{"id":"abc124","text":"bye"}
---

We see a '}{' split between chunks, and sometimes the second object is missing created_at so our validator fails. It only happens when we use streaming handler; non-streaming responses are fine.

emma_support: Thanks — that looks like boundary reassembly got out of sync. Can you also paste the go client streaming snippet you use?

lenora_customer: sure. Minimal repro: 

```go
rc, wc := io.Pipe()
req := &inference.StreamRequest{JsonMode: true} // simplified
go func(){ // simulate network chunks
  wc.Write([]byte("{"))
  wc.Write([]byte("\"id\":\"abc123\",\"text\":\"hello\",\"created_at\":\"2026-03-12T10:00:00Z\"}"))
  time.Sleep(5 * time.Millisecond)
  wc.Write([]byte("{"))
  wc.Write([]byte("\"id\":\"abc124\",\"text\":\"bye\"}"))
  wc.Close()
}()
// client reads rc and feeds into jsonstream parser
```

sarah_sdk: I can reproduce locally with a similar pattern. The parser in the go-sdk streaming layer tries to treat each Read chunk as an independent JSON object when JsonMode=true. If a chunk boundary splits objects we end up attempting to parse "}{" which obviously fails.

kai_go_eng: likely cause: the dechunker that used to be lenient for ndjson assumed newline delimiters; in JSON mode we switched to parsing on Read boundaries for perf. That was a mistake — streaming can have arbitrary boundaries.

emma_support: Thanks team. Lenora, assigning to eng to triage — will escalate. support-bot created ticket TKT-7834 for this thread.

support-bot: New ticket created: TKT-7834 — "go-sdk streaming json_mode: chunk boundary deserialization bug" — priority P2.

kai_go_eng: quick mitigation — please ask customers to set JsonMode=false or use the non-streaming API for the moment. We should also roll a patch that buffers until a complete JSON value is seen (balanced braces) before handing to the serde parser.

lenora_customer: ok can do workaround. Any ETA for a patch? Our pipeline is sensitive, would appreciate a patch or a temporary client release.

kai_go_eng: will prepare a 1.4.1 hotfix that changes streaming dechunker to accumulate bytes until a full top-level JSON value is balanced before parsing. ETA: 48h to PR, 72h to release if tests pass.

sarah_sdk: adding unit tests that simulate interleaved chunk boundaries and also test optional fields omitted across splits. Also will add an integration test that runs against a local tcp proxy that produces the exact '}{' boundary.

emma_support: I'll mark the ticket and email Lenora with the workaround and timeline. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

lenora_customer: thanks — looking forward to the patch. :relieved:

kai_go_eng: note: we should also scan other SDKs (ts, py) for similar logic; might be a common bug. I'll open follow-ups. :eyes:
